description: Public Soxa UI class and data-attribute reference. Sources are repository-relative emission witnesses, not files required by a consuming theme.

conventions.classes: Roots and parts are literal names. Modifiers append to the concrete base class; <block> and <value> are placeholders, not literal selectors. Optional parts exist only while rendered. A part may also carry the classes of its own component.
conventions.data: Scope identifies the node receiving the dataset, not necessarily the component wrapper. TDataset stringifies booleans: false is "false"; only null and undefined remove the attribute. Presence-only gesture flags are documented separately.
conventions.inheritance: TControl supplies data-disabled; TValueControl supplies data-invalid; TInputControl supplies readonly/required class modifiers; TStylable supplies size/variant. Derived components and embedded parts keep their own concrete base classes.
conventions.dynamic: Dynamic entries map source expressions to emitted names or bounded families; sources and expressions are checked for drift.
